_note: Hand-set coordinates that the gazetteer gets wrong, each with the reason. Applied over the machine lookups by geocode.load(). A correction here is a human claim and says so; nothing in this file was guessed, and every entry names what the automatic answer was and why it is not the place the archives mean.

senj.why: Nominatim ranks a HAMLET called Senj at Dugopolje, near Split, above the coastal town — the hamlet is a place/hamlet and the town is a boundary/administrative, so any ranking that prefers populated places picks the wrong one. Every Senj in this estate is the town under the Velebit.

senj croatia.why: As above — the same Dugopolje hamlet outranks the town.

transvaal.why: A province that no longer exists, so there is nothing to match: the bare name resolved to a street in Germany. Gauteng is the part of the old Transvaal this family was actually in, and the coordinate is approximate by nature.

cape colony.why: Also a polity rather than a place; it resolved to the United States. The Eastern Cape is where these records were made, and this is a regional centroid, not a town.

kermpote.why: An older spelling of Krmpote, the Bunjevci settlement in the Senj hinterland. No gazetteer carries the old form, and it is the form this archive's own records use.

kermpote sv jakov.why: As above; Sveti Jakov is the parish it was registered in, not a separate place.

buckwall somerset.why: No Buckwall exists in Somerset. Backwell does, it is two miles from the Butcombe this family also appears in, and the reading is almost certainly a misread B-a-c-k. Marked approximate because the archive has not confirmed it.

st james palace london middlesex england.why: A building, not a settlement, and the gazetteer answers with the parish or nothing. The coordinate is the palace itself; it is marked approximate because a birth said to have happened there is one of this archive's disputed claims, not because the building is hard to find.

st james palace london middlesex englan.why: As above. The place field is truncated mid-word in the source data.

rosario then montevideo.why: Two places in one field. Rosario is where the record begins; Montevideo is where it goes next, and it has its own entry.

neuhaus neckar wurttemberg.why: There are many Neuhauses. This one is given as on the Neckar in Württemberg, and the coordinate is the Württemberg Neuhaus — approximate, because the archive has not yet named which of them its record means.
